title: YouTube — Transcoding Pipeline
subtitle: Distributed GPU fleet for multi-resolution encoding

panels.title: Per-Title Encoding
panels.body:
- Animation: Lower bitrate (simple scenes)
- Sports: Higher bitrate (fast motion)
- Resolution: 360p (fast) → 4K (slow)

panels.title: Parallel Strategy
panels.body:
Videos are split into 4s segments.
Thousands of workers process segments
in parallel for all resolutions.
